summary: The multi-requester run completed but its shared result event names left comparisons incomplete and the newest-read prediction unresolved, so I revised the experiment rather than interpret it: each requester now emits its own reply and completion events, with comparisons correlated only to that requester's admission. Local construction runs pass and show the earliest read answered with the newest context and left at index zero, the middle read likewise, and the newest read completing. Validation reports valid with execution_requested and one experiment create; recording the resulting fact and interpretation awaits the revised receipt.
